max_connections_per_user.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections allowed per user. Higher values support more clients but increase resource usage.

max_pending_activations.description: Maximum number of pending service activation requests per user. Controls concurrency of auto-started services.

max_services_per_user.description: Maximum number of uniquely named services a single user may own on the bus.

max_replies_per_connection.description: Maximum number of pending method call replies per connection. Prevents unbounded memory growth from slow clients.

max_match_rules_per_connection.description: Maximum number of match rules (for signal filtering) per connection.

max_matches_per_rule.description: Maximum number of signal matches per rule. Prevents overly complex signal filters.

enable_audit.description: If true, enable D-Bus audit logging via the audit subsystem (e.g., syslog with audit tags).

socket_path.description: Unix filesystem path where the system bus listener socket will be bound.

enable_systemd.description: If true, integrate with systemd for privileged service activation (required on most modern Linux systems).
